pois.name: Grossmünster & Old Town Zurich
pois.description: Iconic Romanesque twin-towered cathedral founded by Charlemagne in historic Altstadt Zurich with Karlsturm panoramic viewpoint.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic Romanesque landmark overlooking Limmat River
✓ 187-step Karlsturm tower offering panoramic views of Zurich and the Alps
pois.tip: Climb the Karlsturm tower on a clear day for 360-degree views of Zurich Lake and alpine peaks.

pois.name: Lake Zurich Promenade & Bürkliplatz
pois.description: Scenic tree-lined lakeside promenade featuring panoramic alpine views, boat docks, flower gardens, and open swimming piers.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Sweeping vistas across Lake Zurich towards the Glarus Alps
✓ Relaxing pedestrian promenade ideal for sunset walks and boat departures
pois.tip: Catch an afternoon paddle-steamer cruise departing from Bürkliplatz dock across the lake.

pois.name: Bahnhofstrasse & Lindenhof Hill
pois.description: World-famous boutique shopping boulevard leading to elevated Lindenhof Hill, site of a 4th-century Roman fort overlooking the Old Town.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Luxury Swiss watchmakers, chocolate boutiques, and pedestrian boulevards
✓ Shaded hilltop park with historic chess tables and scenic river views
pois.tip: Visit Sprüngli on Paradeplatz for authentic Luxemburgerli macarons while walking up to Lindenhof.

pois.name: Swiss National Museum
pois.description: Fairytale castle-like museum adjacent to Zurich HB showcasing Swiss cultural history, medieval armory, and alpine handicrafts.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Comprehensive heritage of Swiss Confederation from prehistoric times to modern watchmaking
✓ Stunning French-Renaissance chateau architecture beside the river
pois.tip: Free entry with Swiss Travel Pass; family ticket discounts available for children under 16.

provenance.price_source: Official Admission CHF 13 (Free with Swiss Travel Pass)

pois.name: Chapel Bridge (Kapellbrücke) & Water Tower
pois.description: Europe's oldest wooden covered bridge built in 1333, featuring 17th-century triangular roof paintings and the octagonal Wasserturm.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Europe's oldest preserved timber footbridge and Switzerland's most photographed landmark
✓ Intricate triangular historical paintings under the timber canopy depicting Lucerne's history
pois.tip: Stroll across early in the morning when the water reflections of Mount Pilatus are crisp and uncrowded.

pois.name: Lion Monument (Löwendenkmal)
pois.description: Poignant cliff relief carved into natural sandstone commemorating the Swiss Guards massacred during the French Revolution.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Described by Mark Twain as 'the most mournful and moving piece of stone in the world'
✓ Peaceful park setting framed by weeping willows and reflective pool
pois.tip: Located right next to the Glacier Garden (Gletschergarten) of Lucerne.

pois.name: Mount Titlis & Rotair Revolving Cable Car
pois.description: Glaciated 3,238-meter alpine summit reached via Titlis Rotair, the world's first revolving cable car, offering year-round snow and ice activities.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World's first 360-degree rotating aerial tramway soaring to 3,020 meters
✓ Guaranteed glacier snow even in summer with Ice Flyer chairlift and snow tubing
pois.tip: Take the scenic Zentralbahn train from Lucerne to Engelberg (43 min), then free shuttle to cable car station.

provenance.price_source: Adult Round-Trip Cable Car Ticket CHF 96.00 (50% with Swiss Travel Pass)

pois.name: Titlis Cliff Walk & Glacier Cave
pois.description: Europe's highest suspension bridge hanging 500 meters above the abyss at 3,041 meters, plus a 150-meter-long tunnel carved into ancient glacier ice.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Thrilling pedestrian suspension footbridge over sheer glacier cliff
✓ Sub-zero turquoise blue ice grotto lit by dramatic illuminated ice sculptures
pois.tip: Included free with your Mount Titlis cable car ticket; bring warm gloves and windproof jacket.

pois.name: Harder Kulm Panoramic Viewpoint
pois.description: Promontory viewpoint towering 1,322 meters above Interlaken with a glass-bottomed Two Lakes Bridge looking onto Lake Brienz and Lake Thun.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Breathtaking panoramic vantage of Eiger, Mönch, and Jungfrau peaks
✓ Two-Lakes Bridge with cantilevered glass floor overlooking Interlaken valley
pois.tip: Ride the historic funicular railway from Interlaken Ost station in just 10 minutes.

provenance.price_source: Roundtrip Funicular CHF 38.00 (50% with Swiss Pass)

pois.name: Jungfraujoch – Top of Europe
pois.description: Highest railway station in Europe at 3,454 meters, overlooking the vast Great Aletsch Glacier (UNESCO World Heritage Site).
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Crown jewel of the Bernese Alps reached via Eiger Express tri-cable gondola
✓ Sphinx Observatory terrace and vast ice palace carved inside the glacier
pois.tip: Reserve seat tickets in advance during peak summer months; wear UV-rated sunglasses.

provenance.place_verification: UNESCO Swiss Alps Jungfrau-Aletsch World Heritage Site
provenance.price_source: Cogwheel Train & Gondola Mountain Pass (CHF 145.00 discounted fare)

pois.name: Staubbach Falls & Lauterbrunnen Valley
pois.description: Free-falling 297-meter waterfall dropping from a vertical limestone cliff in the valley of 72 waterfalls that inspired Tolkien's Rivendell.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ One of the highest free-falling waterfalls in Europe
✓ Valley trail with galleries carved behind the roaring veil of water
pois.tip: Follow the short illuminated pathway behind the waterfall spray during twilight.

pois.name: Restaurant Zeughauskeller
pois.signature_dish: Swiss Alpine Rösti with Gruyère and Garden Herbs (Vegetarian Rösti)
pois.dish_ingredients: Crispy golden grated Swiss potatoes, melted aged Gruyère AOP, pan-fried onions, fresh mountain rosemary
pois.dietary_suitability: Traditional Swiss Rösti with Vegetarian Options
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Historic 15th-century armory building turned into Zurich's most beloved tavern
✓ Authentic crispy Swiss Rösti and warm hospitality right off Bahnhofstrasse
pois.tip: Table reservations recommended for dinner; try their draft house beer or apple cider.

provenance.dietary_verification: Vegetarian alpine rösti clearly marked on menu

pois.name: Restaurant Swiss Chuchi
pois.signature_dish: Traditional Swiss Moitié-Moitié Cheese Fondue with Crusty Bread & Potatoes
pois.dish_ingredients: 50% Gruyère AOP, 50% Vacherin Fribourgeois AOP, white wine, garlic, kirsch, crusty artisan bread
pois.ai_reason:
✓ The premier fondue restaurant in Zurich's historic Niederdorf Old Town
✓ Traditional Moitié-Moitié cheese blend served with baby potatoes and pickles
pois.tip: Order hot black tea alongside cheese fondue for optimal digestion.

pois.name: Hiltl Restaurant Zurich
pois.signature_dish: Hiltl Gourmet Buffet & Vegetarian Zurich Geschnetzeltes with Golden Rösti
pois.dish_ingredients: Organic mushroom strips in white wine cream sauce, golden Swiss potato rösti, baby herbs
pois.dietary_suitability: 100% Vegetarian & Vegan Certified (World's Oldest Veg Restaurant)
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Guinness World Record holder for the oldest vegetarian restaurant in the world (founded 1898)
✓ Outstanding buffet with over 100 fresh vegetarian and vegan culinary dishes
pois.tip: Take advantage of pay-by-weight buffet or order a la carte Swiss specialties upstairs.

pois.name: Wirtshaus Galliker
pois.signature_dish: Lucerne Potato Rösti with Farmhouse Cheese and Fresh Herbs
pois.dish_ingredients: Slow-roasted crispy grated Swiss potatoes, melted mountain alpine cheese, butter, chives
pois.dietary_suitability: Authentic Swiss Dining with Vegetarian Options
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Family-run historic inn operating for over 4 generations in Lucerne
✓ Honest homestyle Swiss cooking with warm wood-paneled alpine ambiance
pois.tip: Closed Sundays and Mondays; book ahead for evening service.

pois.name: Restaurant Taverne at Interlaken
pois.signature_dish: Bernese Oberland Alpine Macaroni (Älplermagronen) with Applesauce
pois.dish_ingredients: Pennette pasta, tender potato cubes, creamy Swiss cheese sauce, caramelized onions, warm spiced applesauce
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Classic Swiss tavern located on the main Höheweg promenade facing the Jungfrau
✓ Hearty Älplermagronen pasta made using local Bernese mountain cheese
pois.tip: Sit on the garden terrace for panoramic mountain views while dining.
